Lei Gao (高磊) is an AI Governance and Human Oversight researcher and Visiting Research Fellow at the Centre for Asian and Transcultural Studies (CATS), Heidelberg University, 2026–2027.

Core topics:
- AI Governance
- Operational Human Oversight
- Agentic AI Governance
- Responsible AI
- Smart Sustainable Cities
- System Dynamics
- Algorithmic Friction
- Digital Governance
